card.name: Words leading into injection-risk phrases
card.fires_on: Partway through or just before words in warnings about injections and harm, such as unintention-al before intravascular, Intra-Arter-ial before Injection, and protect against before circulatory changes.

modes.label: Inside long words
modes.description: Fires on the ending piece of a long word in injection warnings.
modes.example: similar to systemic toxicity seen with unintention<<al>> intravascular injections of larger doses.

modes.label: Linking words before effects
modes.description: Fires on small words such as against, the, or Including that come before a named effect.
modes.example: Midazolam does not protect<< against>> the characteristic circulatory changes noted after administration

modes.label: Partial word in a web headline
modes.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word in a health headline.
modes.example: Working Long Hours Can Be<< Dep>>ressing, Truly Putting in a lot
